components.name: Navigation
components.description: Shipping navigation pattern with synthetic content.
components.css: .ds-root{font:400 13px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--page)}.ds-root :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:-2px}.ds-root button,.ds-root input{font:inherit;color:inherit}.ds-root button{cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none;text-align:left}.ds-mark{width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round;}.ds-mark .ds-solid{fill: currentColor; stroke: none;}.ds-nav-item{display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 34px; padding: 7px 9px; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--secondary); width: 100%;}.ds-nav-item:hover{background: var(--hover); color: var(--ink);}.ds-nav-item.ds-active{background: var(--hover); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 550;}.ds-primary-nav .ds-nav-item.ds-active .ds-mark{color: var(--accent);}.ds-nav-count{margin-left: auto; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted);}.ds-nav-count.ds-urgent{color: var(--red);}.ds-view-header h1 .ds-mark{color: var(--muted);}.ds-empty > .ds-mark{width: 24px; height: 24px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 4px;}

components.name: Work row
components.description: Shipping work row pattern with synthetic content.
components.css: .ds-root{font:400 13px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--page)}.ds-root :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:-2px}.ds-root button,.ds-root input{font:inherit;color:inherit}.ds-root button{cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none;text-align:left}.ds-mark{width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round;}.ds-mark .ds-solid{fill: currentColor; stroke: none;}.ds-primary-nav .ds-nav-item.ds-active .ds-mark{color: var(--accent);}.ds-view-header h1 .ds-mark{color: var(--muted);}.ds-work-row{display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(120px, 24%) 32px; align-items: center; gap: 2px 12px; width: 100%; padding: 11px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink);}.ds-work-row:hover{background: var(--hover);}.ds-work-row.ds-row-selected{background: var(--selection);}.ds-row-icon{align-self: start; display: flex; padding-top: 2px; color: var(--muted);}.ds-work-row.ds-red .ds-row-icon, .ds-work-row.ds-red .ds-row-status{color: var(--red);}.ds-work-row.ds-amber .ds-row-icon, .ds-work-row.ds-amber .ds-row-status{color: var(--amber);}.ds-work-row.ds-green .ds-row-icon{color: var(--green);}.ds-row-content, .ds-row-meta{display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 0;}.ds-row-title{font-weight: 550; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;}.ds-row-preview, .ds-row-context{color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;}.ds-row-preview{color: var(--secondary);}.ds-row-status{font-size: 12px; color: var(--secondary); overflow-wrap: anywhere;}.ds-row-age{color: var(--muted); text-align: right; font-size: 11px; align-self: start; padding-top: 2px;}.ds-lane-row .ds-row-title{font-weight: 400;}.ds-empty > .ds-mark{width: 24px; height: 24px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 4px;}

narrative.overview:
Linear-inspired task management: compact grouped work, familiar navigation, and one focused detail view. The interface favors the owner's scanning task over expanded ledger prose.

Neutral OS themes fit a pinned browser tab used alongside Herdr in changing ambient light. Complete ledger content remains readable after opening a row; all controls change local presentation only.
keyCharacteristics: Priority inbox and consistent list rows.
Tonal navigation and group surfaces with thin dividers.
One system font family and tabular numerals.
Machine identity and global attention counts across filtered views.
Focused details preserve complete text and actual destinations.

rules.name: The Status Words Rule
rules.body: An icon and color always accompany a written status.

rules.name: The Complete Detail Rule
rules.body: A compact list preview must open the complete ledger text.

rules.name: The Global Counts Rule
rules.body: Local filters never rewrite global attention counts or imply that hidden work is clear.

dos: **Do** keep status words, machine identity, keyboard focus and full detail text reachable.
**Do** use the same compact controls and neutral surfaces in both OS themes.
**Do** distinguish snapshot health, server truncation and local filters.
donts: **Don't** expand long ledger paragraphs into the default work list.
**Don't** add ledger-write controls or pretend to focus a remote pane.
**Don't** render ledger text as HTML or fetch runtime fonts/assets from a CDN.
